fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck entrance is an open driveway off the E-W public road (N Alsup Rd / industrial collector) at the SW corner of the property. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, guard booth, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in z20 satellite (2026) or 2024 Street View. The dock apron is not enclosed by perimeter fence - open desert site. Open driveway = no controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure at the entrance in any view.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single south-facing dock bank running the length of the building; ~70 doors estimated from regular bay rhythm, low confidence as imagery resolution limited the count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Building dock apron held only a few trailers in 2026 imagery; no marked drop-trailer stalls. CJ occupies only half the ~663k sq ft building (~331,686 SF) so the yard is lightly used.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot - the large dirt lot east of the building is undeveloped vacant land, not a trailer yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide deep concrete apron between the road entrance and the dock doors; ample queuing room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron and abundant unused paved/dirt width to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock doors on a single (south) building face; no separate ship/receive dock clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Building sits amid irrigated farmland and open desert on the far western fringe of the Phoenix metro (Glendale/Litchfield Park boundary); judged Rural per the broader open-country setting.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is on the metro fringe but not deeply isolated - within an emerging industrial corridor near Glendale Municipal Airport; cellular coverage likely adequate, marked false (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from the developed parcel (building + south apron + parking, ~320m x ~510m); the large vacant lot to the east is excluded.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; no rail line adjacent.
